notes: Illinois has no single public calendar grid. Events come from (1) the Wix event pages (each registration event has its own page; all were found through the site’s event sitemap), (2) the Youth Department’s 2026 "Upcoming Events" PDF and (3) the Hispanic Ministries 2026 calendar PDF, plus conference news for attendance. Duplicate listings across these sources were merged (alsoListed). Conference-level departments without a public event list: women’s, prayer, ACS, health, stewardship (their pages carry no dated events). The 2026 conference theme is "Experiencing the Lord of Hope". In March 2026 the conference ran five special town halls and a special constituency session about relocating the conference office. Tentative youth mission trips (June and July 2026) and the August Alaska mission camp are from the youth calendar and may not have taken place as listed.
